rationale: regime v2 (2026-06-11, the N-4 discussion): early-noise/late-precision. The v1 whole-game tau-sampling (K=999) measured 40-46% non-argmax moves and significantly longer games -- late noise corrupts the outcome labels of every earlier record. v2: tau=0.7 sampling for turns 0-11 only (past the opening book, through the early-mid region where the MB-flavour data bias lives) + EpsilonLate=0.05 (turns >=12: argmax with a 5% uniform-child chance, ~1.1 mild deviations/game). N stays 1000 -- argmax now governs most moves, so N's argmax quality matters MORE. tau=0.7 unchanged from the pre-agreed probe rule (eval/tau_probe_n1000.json). Data mix: 2/3 general (RL_SelfPlay_General, no forcing -- broadened general-improvement goal) + 1/3 forced-Hotel (RL_Step2_Smoke -- keeps IG-decision density).
